culpritSource.quote: The culprit is Yukiko Mori. First, she knew Kiyomi was leaving first, saw her off at the station, and established what time she boarded the train. She timed how long it would take for the body to loop back around to the station and return.

motive.quote: So that when Kiyomi put on the headphones the needle would prick her ear introducing the poisoning and thus killing her.

method.quote: The murder weapon is the headphones, before giving them to Kiyomi she had rigged them with a small needle coated with poison.

evidence.quote: The murder weapon is the headphones, before giving them to Kiyomi she had rigged them with a small needle coated with poison.

motive.zhHans: 这样，当 Kiyomi 戴上耳机时，针就会刺进她的耳朵，注入毒物，从而杀死她。两人上车时，Yukiko 取耳机花了很久——因为 Kiyomi 已陷入尸僵，耳机被卡住了，她用力一扯，竟把耳机扯断了。
motive.en: So that when Kiyomi put on the headphones the needle would prick her ear introducing the poisoning and thus killing her. When they boarded the train, Yukiko took too long to retrieve the headphones as they were stuck because Kiyomi was in rigor she yanked them so hard that they snapped.

method.zhHans: 凶器就是那副耳机：在把它交给 Kiyomi 之前，她已经在耳机上装了一根涂了毒的细针。这样，当 Kiyomi 戴上耳机时，针就会刺进她的耳朵，注入毒物，从而杀死她。
method.en: The murder weapon is the headphones, before giving them to Kiyomi she had rigged them with a small needle coated with poison. So that when Kiyomi put on the headphones the needle would prick her ear introducing the poisoning and thus killing her.

evidence.zhHans: 凶器就是那副耳机：在把它交给 Kiyomi 之前，她已经在耳机上装了一根涂了毒的细针。
evidence.en: The murder weapon is the headphones, before giving them to Kiyomi she had rigged them with a small needle coated with poison.

resolution.zhHans: 犯人是 Yukiko Mori。首先，她知道 Kiyomi 会先出发，便到车站送行，并确认了她上车的时间。她算好了尸体绕行一圈回到车站所需的时间。凶器就是那副耳机：在把它交给 Kiyomi 之前，她已经在耳机上装了一根涂了毒的细针。这样，当 Kiyomi 戴上耳机时，针就会刺进她的耳朵，注入毒物，从而杀死她。
resolution.en: The culprit is Yukiko Mori. First, she knew Kiyomi was leaving first, saw her off at the station, and established what time she boarded the train. She timed how long it would take for the body to loop back around to the station and return. The murder weapon is the headphones, before giving them to Kiyomi she had rigged them with a small needle coated with poison. So that when Kiyomi put on the headphones the needle would prick her ear introducing the poisoning and thus killing her.

summary.en:
Kogoro, Ran, and Conan are waiting for the train when they notice a group of people leaving work on a Sunday. Once they boarded the train, the group finds their co-worker dead in an empty train car.

Location: Train (JR Yamanote Line) car 2

suspects: Seiji Kurata, Shizuka Kawai, and Yukiko Mori
